output.summary: Deploy a secure, high-performance static website for csce412advaithr07.me using a private S3 origin, CloudFront CDN with OAC, an ACM-issued TLS certificate, Route 53 DNS routing, and custom 404 error handling.
requirements: Store the five static website pages and custom 404 asset in an Amazon S3 bucket with all public access strictly blocked.
Serve all web traffic via an Amazon CloudFront distribution using Origin Access Control (OAC) to access the S3 origin privately.
Provision and validate an SSL/TLS certificate for csce412advaithr07.me via AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) in us-east-1.
Enforce HTTPS delivery across all distribution paths via automatic HTTP-to-HTTPS redirection.
Route apex domain traffic to CloudFront via Amazon Route 53 alias (A/AAAA) records.
Configure CloudFront custom error response to serve a custom 404.html page for missing objects without exposing S3 error details.
service_dependencies: S3: Acts as the private origin storage for static HTML/CSS/JS files and the custom 404 page, denying all public read access except via authenticated CloudFront OAC requests.
CloudFront: Acts as the CDN and edge-routing layer, enforcing HTTPS, caching static assets, managing custom 404 error mapping, and securely querying S3 via OAC.
ACM: Issues and manages the public SSL/TLS certificate in the us-east-1 region for HTTPS termination at the CloudFront edge.
Route 53: Manages the authoritative public hosted zone, provides DNS validation records for ACM, and routes apex domain traffic to CloudFront via alias records.
risks: ACM validation may stall if the external domain registrar is not properly delegating nameserver authority to the Route 53 hosted zone.
Incorrect S3 bucket policy or OAC misconfiguration may result in 403 Forbidden errors for valid site visitors.
CloudFront edge propagation time may cause temporary delays in verifying DNS and SSL configurations.
Incorrect HTTP status code mapping on custom 404 error responses could cause SEO indexing issues or unexpected caching behavior.

tasks.action: Request a public TLS certificate in ACM (us-east-1) for csce412advaithr07.me using DNS validation.

Apply a bucket policy to the S3 bucket allowing s3:GetObject exclusively to the CloudFront distribution ARN via OAC.
Create Route 53 A and AAAA alias records for csce412advaithr07.me pointing to the CloudFront distribution domain name.
Validate HTTPS resolution, HTTP-to-HTTPS redirection, custom 404 page rendering, and confirm direct access to S3 objects returns 403 Forbidden.
